features.name: Fighting Style
features.desc: A Fighting Style feat of your choice (e.g., Defense, Archery, Dueling).

features.name: Second Wind
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level. Limited number of uses (regained on a rest).

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.desc: You can use the mastery properties of 3 kinds of weapons (the number increases with level).

features.name: Action Surge
features.desc: On your turn, you can take one additional action (except the Magic action). 1 use (2 from level 17).

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.desc: When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to it; the use isn't expended if the check still fails.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You make two attacks when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.desc: When you use Second Wind, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Indomitable
features.desc: You can reroll a failed saving throw (adding your Fighter level to the result). More uses at levels 13 and 17.

features.name: Tactical Master
features.desc: When you attack with a weapon, you can replace its mastery property with Push, Topple, or Slow.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.desc: You can attack three times when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.desc: When you miss a creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of the current turn.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.desc: You can attack four times when you take the Attack action.
